ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AC=4$, $BC=3$, then what is the value of $\sin B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle C=90^\circ$, AC=4, BC=3, \\
therefore AB=5, \\
therefore $\sin B= \frac{AC}{AB}=\boxed{\frac{4}{5}}$
